Name: Classical Garden Statues
Author: AirynS
Description:
Designed for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16390]Fancy Garden Farm [/url]map, this mod adds beautiful classical statues as custom buildings with Solid Foundations! Each statue is designed to match together for a cohesive and elegant aesthetic while still having its own unique character. They can also be enchanted at the Wizard's so that they provide minor buffs to various skills!

Two statues are available to purchase through Robin's farm buildings menu: the Classical Garden Statue and the Half-Size Garden Statue. By default, the purchase cost is 1,000g and 40 or 30 stone respectively, but this can be customised in the CP configuration options.

Once at least one Classical Garden Statue is present on your farm, additional options become available in the Wizard's building menu: the Enchanted Deity, Desert, Earth, Farm, Island, Lantern, Modern, Warrior, and Water Statues. These are upgrades to the Classical Garden Statue which by default cost 1,000g, two solar essences and two void essences, and each provides a +2 buff to a different skill that by default lasts 3 in-game hours. The purchase cost and buff duration for the Enchanted Statues are also customisable via the CP configuration options.

For a version of these statues as replacements for the obelisks, including custom obelisks added by other mods, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16374]Classical Garden Statue Obelisks[/url]!

For even more statues, check out Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17577]H&W's Romantic Furniture[/url]!

[b][size=5][center]Requirements[/center]
[/size][/b]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url]. An optional CP pack adds additional configuration settings.

[b][size=5]
[/size][/b][center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]

To install, simply extract the "Classical Garden Statues" folder and drop it in your Mods folder. The "[SF] Classical Garden Statues" folder inside is required, while the "[CP] Classical Garden Statues" folder is optional but highly recommended.


[center][b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]﻿[/center]

Classical Garden Statues has built-in skin options to give different looks to the Classical and Half-Size Garden Statues. Once upgraded to the Enchanted Statues, new skin options with foliage and flowers in various colours also become available.

The CP Classical Garden Statues also adds three configuration options:

[list]
[*][b]"Statue Cost"[/b] - This option changes the purchase cost for all statues. "Cheap" changes it to 100g and 5 stone for the Classical and Half-Size Garden Statues and 100g and 1 quartz for the Enchanted Statues, while "Expensive" changes it to 10,000g and 150 stone for the Classical and Half-Size Garden Statues and 10,000g, 5 solar essences, 5 void essences, and 5 quartz for the Enchanted Statues.
[*][b]"Buff Duration" [/b]- This option changes how long the buffs granted by the Enchanted Statues lasts.
[*][b]"Seasonal Foliage"[/b] - This option changes the Enchanted Statues' textures so that they change seasonally. Note: This option does nothing for the Classical and Half-Size Garden Statues and will override existing skins for Enchanted Statues.
[/list]


[center][b][size=5]Translations

[/size][/b][/center]Anyone who would like to make a translation of this mod is very welcome and is fine to upload their translation separately. However, translation files must require the original mod and must not redistribute art files.
